the_thing_worth_reading_twice: A SENTENCE THAT DECIDES SOMETHING WILL KEEP DECIDING IT AFTER ITS REASON IS GONE. Route 2 was elected because route 1 required 'repeated human posting'. Twenty-six minutes later the same file recorded that the evidence describes ONE post, not a recurring operation — the exclusion's entire ground, withdrawn, in the same document. Eleven hours and at least four laps of route-2 work followed. Nobody was careless: the correction was written carefully, dated, and cross-referenced. It simply had no reader, and neither did the thing it corrected. The generalisation for the next lap: a correction is not finished when it is written next to the error. It is finished when the machine that acted on the error reads the correction instead. If you cannot name that machine, you have written a note.
